title: Shark wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,32 62,32' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 44,20 50,18' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 56,20 50,18' fill='#3ec7ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='3' fill='#ffe75e'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='14' ry='3' fill='#d92e83'/>
  <!-- Shark body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='62' rx='32' ry='20' fill='#4a90d9'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='68' rx='28' ry='14' fill='#8ec5f0'/>
  <!-- Dorsal fin -->
  <polygon points='35,44 42,26 52,44' fill='#3a76b8'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <polygon points='13,58 2,46 4,64' fill='#3a76b8'/>
  <polygon points='13,62 2,76 4,62' fill='#4a90d9'/>
  <!-- Pectoral fin -->
  <polygon points='38,70 30,84 48,76' fill='#3a76b8'/>
  <!-- Belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='74' rx='20' ry='5' fill='#cbe6ff'/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='56' r='5' fill='#0e2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='54.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Smile / mouth -->
  <path d='M66 66 Q72 70 68 72' stroke='#1d4f85' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Teeth -->
  <polygon points='64,68 66,72 68,68' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <polygon points='69,67 71,71 73,67' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Gill lines -->
  <path d='M74 54 Q77 60 74 66' stroke='#2f66a8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M79 53 Q82 60 79 67' stroke='#2f66a8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='71' cy='63' r='3' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
